proof_scope: live provider dispatch and live multi-seat panels through the real Ask runtime

claims.proves: that a seat either answers with real content or names its blocker, that a rate-limited seat self-recovers to its configured fallback AND records the substitution, that no seat dispatches a nonexistent model, that a live roundtable reaches three ANSWERING seats and passes its own compliance audit, that a live competition reaches two answering candidates, that a five-creator compete DAG with an independent claude-opus-5-low judge produces a 'WINNER: <node-id>' verdict with rationale and passes panel-audit, that a two-seat panel is refused rather than reported as a panel, and that an MVP unblock dispatches isolated candidates against a real blocker and passes the best-practices-competition audit while refusing a solo candidate
claims.does_not_prove: that any given provider is available at run time, or semantic correctness of any response. Quorum is a floor on delivery, not on quality: three seats returning the token proves the transport seats a panel, never that the panel is right.

capability_claims.description: One lane's failure degrades lane-local through the tau join contract; healthy seats always run to terminal and the join always settles.
Seats dispatch only real catalog models; removed or rate-limited seats self-recover to their recorded substitution, and a misnamed model relays the transport's course correction.
Every browser seat opens (or is bound to) its own usable tab and answers from it; ambient rate-limited or hidden tabs never silently remove a seat.
Competitions run isolated candidate lanes with an identical packet and an independent judge whose verdict names an existing answering candidate; rigged verdicts fail the audit.
Eval verdicts are bound to their own invocation (nonces, exact ask-ids, seat identity, executed artifacts); stale, mismatched, or self-reported evidence is refused.

failure_modes: one NEEDS_ATTENTION lane blocks the join and cancels healthy sibling futures
a failed single lane leaves the run with no join at all
a nonexistent model is dispatched anyway
a removed seat vanishes without a recorded substitution
scillm's course-correction 400 is swallowed instead of relayed
a seat submits into a hidden or rate-limited ambient tab
an unbound run reuses another lane's tab
a judge that is also a creator picks itself
a winner is declared that never answered or does not exist
a stale green run is graded in place of a failed current one
a wrong-seat or tokenless receipt is credited
a self-reported success is trusted without execution

cases.name: live-compete-five-creators-judged-by-opus5-low-picks-a-winner
command: set -o pipefail; cd .. && AID=ask-compete-add2-eval-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ) && SURF_WEBGPT_REASONING=Instant uv run --project . python -m ask.tau_dag_cli compete 'Objective: Write exactly one Python function that adds two numbers. Immutable goal: a single function add(a: float, b: float) -> float returning the sum, complying with best-practices-python: full type hints, docstring, no side effects, no I/O. Expected output: APPROACH, CHANGES (one python code block), RISKS, PROOF_COMMANDS (exactly one FULLY SELF-CONTAINED python -c command that defines the function inline; it must not read files or import local modules). Forbidden claims: do not claim tests were run. Proof boundary: the project agent runs PROOF_COMMANDS locally.' --repo local/agent-skills --target ask-agentic-eval-compete-add2 --immutable-goal 'One best-practices-python-compliant add-two-numbers function selected by an independent judge with a written rationale.' --handler webgpt --handler webclaude --handler webgemini --handler oc-deepseek --handler webgrok --judge-handler claude-opus-5-low --criterion best-practices-python-compliance --criterion correctness --criterion minimality --ask-id "$AID" --execute --json --poll-timeout-seconds 1500 --poll-interval-seconds 5 | tail -60 > /tmp/compete-cli-$AID.out; rc=$?; cat /tmp/compete-cli-$AID.out; RD=/mnt/storage12tb/skills/ask/outputs/.ask_artifacts/tau-dag-runs/"$AID" && { [ $rc -eq 0 ] || grep -q '"removed_seats": \[' /tmp/compete-cli-$AID.out || { echo CLI_FAILED_WITHOUT_RECORDED_REMOVAL; exit 1; }; } && ./run.sh panel-audit "$RD" --mode compete && ./run.sh judge-audit "$RD" --run-winner-proof && grep -E '^WINNER: handler-' "$RD"/node-artifacts/judge/response.md
cases.notes: Five isolated creators (mixed browser + scillm transports) each write add(a,b) per best-practices-python; claude-opus-5-low judges all receipts and must emit 'WINNER: <node-id>' with a rationale. panel-audit enforces >=2 answered candidates and packet isolation. First green live run 2026-08-19: 5/5 candidates PASS, judge picked handler-webgpt; winner's PROOF_COMMANDS ran locally exit 0 and the judge's SyntaxError claim against oc-deepseek's proof reproduced locally exit 1. 2026-08-19 provenance fix: the audited run dir is the exact --ask-id of this invocation (no newest-dir glob), and pipefail stops a failed tau run from being masked by tail. 2026-08-19: judge-audit chained after panel-audit -- independence (judge is not a creator), verdict names an existing competitor that answered, every competitor addressed in the rationale, and the winner's own PROOF_COMMANDS executed exit 0. 2026-08-19 wave-1 hardening: the packet now demands a fully self-contained python -c proof (a judged winner shipped 'import add' and failed judge-audit --run-winner-proof), and the case chain tolerates a nonzero cli exit ONLY when removed_seats is recorded (ambient rate limits removed webclaude and webgrok with substitutions mid-wave; honest degradation must not read as a compete failure, while an unrecorded seat loss still fails).
